reference.title: Search for a motor
reference.shortdesc: On the Dashboard page, you can also search for a motor using the search box

section.p: On the Dashboard page, you can also search for a motor using the search box and the left navigation menu.
section.note: Note: The search box is not available in the SMS mobile app.
section.p: The following table describes the labels in the above image:

row.entry: At the highest level is the list of locations.
Within each location is a list of plants.
Each plant contains a list of specific processes.
Finally, under each process, there is a list of motors associated with that process.
The numerical indicator to the right displays the number of motors being monitored at each level.

section.p: Table Elements on the Left Navigation Pane
Expand and collapse a location name, plant name, and a process name to view or hide its associated motors.
section.note: Note: Clicking a specific motor on the left navigation menu takes you to the motor’s information page.

ol.li: Log in to the SMS web application.
On the Dashboard, locate the Search motors text box.

li.p: Start typing a keyword associated with the motor.
As you type, a list of suggestions matching your input appears below the search box.

ol.li: Select the required motor from the suggestions list.

section.title: Result
section.p: The motor name is highlighted on the navigation pane and the corresponding motor information page is displayed on the right.
